messages.subject: size of symbols in legend
parts:
Hi,

I have an issue with the size of the legend in the following plot

weight<-runif(18,0,1)*4
x<-rep(1:6,3)
y<-c(log(1:6),log(1:6)+1,log(1:6)+2)
fac<-factor(rep(1:3,each=6))

dat<-data.frame(x,y,fac,poids)

ggplot(dat, aes(x=x,y=y,group=fac)) +
  geom_line(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac)) +
  geom_point(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac,shape=fac,size=weight))


I would like to enlarge the symbols in the legend (the "fac" part) so as to make the shapes appear clearly.

Any ideas ?

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: size of symbols in legend
parts:
On 4/23/2013 5:08 PM, Hannibal HARBAREC wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I have an issue with the size of the legend in the following plot
>
> weight<-runif(18,0,1)*4
> x<-rep(1:6,3)
> y<-c(log(1:6),log(1:6)+1,log(1:6)+2)
> fac<-factor(rep(1:3,each=6))
>
> dat<-data.frame(x,y,fac,poids)
>
> ggplot(dat, aes(x=x,y=y,group=fac)) +
> geom_line(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac)) +
> geom_point(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac,shape=fac,size=weight))
>
>

> I would like to enlarge the symbols in the legend (the "fac" part) so as
> to make the shapes appear clearly.
>
> Any ideas ?
Well, the following is supposed to work:

geom_point(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac,shape=fac,size=weight)) +
scale_shape_discrete(guide=guide_legend(override.aes=aes(size=3)))

But it doesn't because of a bug, I think. The aesthetic of the wrong
part is being overridden. If shape is in a separate legend you can see
the size changed.

geom_point(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac,shape=fac,size=weight)) +
scale_shape_discrete("bleh",
guide=guide_legend(override.aes=aes(size=3)))


--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University

I was working on a bug report, and I have not completely convinced
myself it is a bug. In specifying the legend, I don't know how it would
be to specify an overridden aesthetic for one part of the legend (the
point) and not for the the same aesthetic for another (the line). It
would have to be something about not using an overridden aesthetic for
all parts when legends get combined. Here is another alternative:
suppress the thick lines in the legend:

scale_shape_discrete(guide=guide_legend(override.aes=aes(size=3,
linetype=0))

> ggplot(dat, aes(x=x,y=y,group=fac)) +
> geom_line(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac)) +
> geom_point(stat="identity",aes(colour=fac,shape=fac,size=weight)) +
> scale_shape_discrete("bleh",
> guide=guide_legend(override.aes=aes(size=3)))
